'''Wall Bennis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a member of the [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Wall Bennis was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and ultimately assigned to work as the [[Director/Legends|director]] of the [[Marfa]]-based labs of the [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]]. Serving the AgriCorps during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Bennis worked with [[Hestizo Trace]] in researching flora on the planet. During their work one morning, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tulkh]] infiltrated the facility in search for the [[Murakami orchid]] on behalf of [[Darth Scabrous]]. While Trace was tending to another sections of the facility, Tulkh impaled Trace with a spear. Trace saw Bennis' body impaled on a [[Malpassian squid pine]] and attempted to flee before being captured by Tulkh.<ref name="RH" />

While Bennis was gravely injured, [[Jedi healer/Legends|Jedi healers]] were able to treat him in time. Making a full recovery, Bennis bore a scar on his chest where he had been impaled. Bennis greeted Trace when she returned from her imprisonment with the Empire, and encouraged her when she decided to return to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="RH" />
